'''Coonee''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was in his teens, and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] traveled to Coonee where they herded [[coldppeda]]s, fifteen-footed scaled domestic animals, for three years.

==Behind the scenes==
It was created by [[George Lucas]] shortly after the release of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] in [[1977]] as part of the back-story of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Coonee was never incorporated into Han's biography, despite the fact that Lucas developed it for the use of licensees in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. However, the unused backstory is referred to as in-universe rumors in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
